encodingDesc.p: The page image is authoritative. Hathi OCR and the 2014 XML are comparison witnesses only. Printed text is not silently corrected. Verse lines use numbered l elements. Citation hierarchy is author.work.fragment.line.

cRefPattern.p: This pointer pattern extracts lines within fragments.

revisionDesc.change: Split the volume-level OCR draft into canonical TLG author and work files. Running-head continuations were folded into their works; wording was not corrected. The page image remains authoritative and the transcription requires human review.

lg.l: μὴ Κτησίας μόνος. B. τί γὰρ σὲ κωλύει;
Α. δείπνου γὰρ οὗτος, ὡς λέγουσιν οἱ σοφοί,

div.note: Athenaeus 10, 416 de Ἀναξίλας δὲ ὁ κωμικὸς περὶ Κτησίου διαλεγόμενος... κἀν Πλουσίοις (πλουσιος A) κτλ. Aelianus V. h. 1, 27 καὶ Κτησίαν δέ φησί τινα Ἀναξίλας ὁ τῆς κωμῳδίας ποιητὴς πολλὰ ἐσθίειν.

1. utique scribendum est δειπνῶν γ' ἴσον et pro χἄτερος fortasse καὶ Κραναός. cf. fr. 30. 2. τί γὰρ σὲ κωλύει, i. e. quid tibi illius libido nocet? certe te nihil inpedit quominus quantum vis vores. 3. οἱ σοφοί ei sunt, qui hominem initium quidem vitae nosse dicunt, exitum non item. v. 3 et 4 a reliquis ut varietatem fr. 31 separandos censet Herwerd. Nov. add. crit. 28.
Diogenes Laert. 3, 28 χλευάζει δ' αὐτὸν (Πλάτωνα) καὶ Ἀναξίλας ἐν... Πλουσίαις (sic).
